deviations: The wave-A wage-transparency item and the wave-B reporting-website item share one survey variable (transparencyanchor); each is z-scored on its own wave's pure control group and the two enter the Anderson policy-demand index as a single component (5 components per respondent).

Anderson (2008) index weights are the row sums of the inverse covariance matrix of the standardized components, computed in the pure control group (Tables 3-5) or the full follow-up sample (Table 6); the index is the weighted mean of the available components and is not re-standardized.

Posterior belief z-scored with the pooled mean/sd of the treatment-arm sample (the paper does not state the reference group); chosen after a claim comparison showed control-group scaling gave -0.587 vs the claimed -0.658.

Probability weights rebuilt from Appendix G.1 (wave B only: age 18-24 female 0.6298 / male 1.4615; age 55-65 female 0.8691 / male 1.0184; all others 1); they match the pweight column of the follow-up files for every matched respondent.
Trim for Tables 3-4: pure control group with prior strictly between the unweighted 5th and 95th percentiles (50 and 113) of the control-group prior distribution (n=921).
notes: Built everything from the raw LimeSurvey exports (SurveyStageI_Wave{A,B}_raw.dta) using the answer codes in the .lss survey files (read only as survey metadata). Treatment arm from RAND (1=ACS/T74, 2=CPS/T94, 0=pure control), confirmed by the survey logic and by the rand variable in the follow-up files. Covariates (region, age groups, party, log household income, employment, 2-year college+, children, prior) were coded from the raw answers and checked against the constructed covariates in the follow-up files (100% agreement, prior 99.9%). Table 3/4: OLS of z-scored outcomes (pure control mean/sd) on Democrat, Female, Independent, other, wave B (Panel A) or prior z-scored on the full pure control group plus wave B (Panel B); pweights, HC1 SEs. Table 5: treatment arms (n=3031; 3022 with posterior), controls as listed in the paper, OLS and 2SLS (fixest) with T74 instrumenting z-scored posterior. Table 6: follow-up files (n=1105) merged to main-survey covariates by panelID; outcomes z-scored on the full follow-up sample; wave-B randomized matrix order (wageproblem vs wageproblem2, with high/low-skilled rows swapped) coalesced. Individual-item columns reproduce the paper exactly (e.g. Table 3 cols 1-3, Table 4 cols 1-6, Table 6 cols 3-6). Remaining small gaps: raw first stage -12.950 vs -12.955; policy-index reduced form 0.059 vs 0.056 (IV -0.090 vs -0.087), probably from the exact index-weighting sample. attempt-2 was an exploratory run (survey codebook + cross-tabs) that crashed at a diagnostic table after printing what was needed; it printed no RESULT lines and was not repaired. Scripts were run from a private scratch directory and copied here; no run hung.
